description: Apply one or more editing verbs to the document as ONE undoable change. Verbs: add_media, add_text, add_color, trim, move, split, remove, remove_silence, cut_words, remove_retakes, caption_speech, reframe, set_framing, set_loudness, transition. remove_silence cuts the pauses out of a media clip (sensitivity 0–1, default 0.5) and moves later clips on its track up; it applies nothing when no pause is found. cut_words cuts words fromIndex..toIndex out of a clip, sending the transcriptId from the timeline_transcript call they came from; remove_retakes cuts the earlier take of each phrase said twice in a row. caption_speech turns stored transcripts into captions on a track above the video (short phrases, or one word at a time with maxWords 1), replacing captions already there; export burns them in. Captions do not move with later cuts, so caption after cutting, or run it again after a cut. On a portrait canvas they sit above the bottom quarter and stay narrow enough to keep clear of the Shorts, Reels and TikTok overlays (margin sets the distance from the edge), and their width follows the font size. reframe changes the output shape (aspect 9:16 for Shorts/Reels/TikTok, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9) and fills it (fit cover, the default, crops; contain shows bars); x/y (0 = left/top, 0.5 = center, 1 = right/bottom) pick the part of every current media clip that shows. set_framing sets the fit, zoom (scale 0.1–4) and position of one media clip. Check the result with timeline_show atSec. set_loudness sets the integrated loudness the mp4 export normalizes to (targetLufs -14 for YouTube/Shorts/Reels/TikTok, -16 for podcasts, null for off). make_short turns a long recording into a vertical short on a timeline of its own: send it with `timeline` set to a new id such as "best-1" (never main). It plays the given word ranges (read the source timeline's sentences with timeline_transcript and no clipId; the source defaults to main) with a little padding, cut from the source's clips so its silence and retake cuts carry in, on a 9:16 canvas filled edge to edge (x picks the part of the frame that shows), normalized to -14 LUFS, with captions. Pick whole sentences (15–60 s in all is typical); the result's warnings name a range that starts or ends mid-sentence. Look at a frame with timeline_show (same timeline, atSec), then adjust with reframe x. Undo on that timeline removes it; replace rebuilds it. Every other verb also takes `timeline`, so a short can be edited like main. Batch related verbs into a single call. Media paths must be inside the workspace. Returns the updated document summary, including whether it can now render.

timeline.description: Timeline to work on (default "main"). A short made with make_short is a timeline of its own.

id.description: Optional clip id — supply one to reference this clip in a later verb of the SAME batch.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to a video/audio/image file.

sourceOutSec.description: Trim out-point within the source (default the full duration).

startSec.description: Timeline start; default appends after the last clip.

track.description: Track id to place it on (default: the main video track).

background.description: Box color behind the text, or null for none.

durationSec.description: How long the text is on screen.

id.description: Optional clip id — supply one to reference this clip in a later verb of the SAME batch.

startSec.description: Timeline start; default appends after the last clip.

color.description: Card color: a name like black or white, or hex like #ffcc00 (default black).

id.description: Optional clip id — supply one to reference this clip in a later verb of the SAME batch.

toTrack.description: Move the clip to this track.

atSec.description: Timeline time to cut at (must fall inside the clip).

clipId.description: Media clip to cut the pauses out of. It is split into back-to-back sub-clips that keep the speech, and later clips on its track move up.

sensitivity.description: How aggressively to cut, 0..1. Higher counts louder sound as silence and cuts shorter pauses. Default 0.5.

clipId.description: Media clip to cut the words out of.

fromIndex.description: First word to cut: its `index` from timeline_transcript.

toIndex.description: Last word to cut (inclusive). Later clips on the track move up.

transcriptId.description: The `transcriptId` from the timeline_transcript call the indices came from; the cut is refused if the clip was transcribed again since.

clipId.description: Media clip to cut repeated takes from: each phrase said twice in a row loses its earlier take (see `retakes` in timeline_transcript).

transcriptId.description: Optional `transcriptId` the retakes were read from; refused if it changed.

background.description: Box color behind the text (default black@0.6), or null for none.

clipId.description: Media clip to caption. Default: every media clip whose source has a transcript, replacing the whole caption track.

margin.description: How far, in pixels, captions keep from the bottom (or top) edge. Default: a quarter of the height on a portrait canvas, clear of the Shorts, Reels and TikTok overlays; 40 otherwise.

maxWords.description: Most words per caption (default 7); 1 shows one word at a time. A pause or a sentence end also starts a new caption.

track.description: Caption track id (default "captions"), kept above the video.

transcriptId.description: Optional `transcriptId` (with clipId) the words were read from; refused if it changed.

aspect.description: Output shape: 9:16 (vertical: Shorts, Reels, TikTok), 1:1, 4:5 (feed) or 16:9. Keeps the canvas short side, so 1920x1080 becomes 1080x1920.

fit.description: cover (default): fill the frame and crop what overflows. contain: show the whole picture with bars.

height.description: Exact canvas height in pixels (even), with width, instead of aspect.

width.description: Exact canvas width in pixels (even), with height, instead of aspect.

x.description: Horizontal position for every media clip now on the timeline: 0 shows the left edge of the source, 0.5 the center, 1 the right edge. Clips added later start centered; frame them with set_framing.

y.description: Vertical position for every media clip now on the timeline: 0 top, 1 bottom.

fit.description: This clip's fit: cover fills the frame, contain shows all of it, inherit follows the canvas again.

reset.description: Start from the canvas default (its fit, centered, unzoomed) before the rest.

scale.description: Zoom: 1 = fitted size, 1.3 = a punch-in, below 1 = smaller with bars.

x.description: Horizontal position: 0 shows the left edge of the source, 0.5 center, 1 right.

targetLufs.description: Normalize the exported mp4 to this integrated loudness in LUFS: -14 for YouTube, Shorts, Reels and TikTok, -16 for podcasts. null turns it off. Applies to mp4 export only.

captions.description: Burn in captions from the transcript (default true).

maxWords.description: Most words per caption (default 7); 1 shows one word at a time.

ranges.description: Word ranges, played in this order (a later moment can open the short as its hook). Pick whole sentences from the timeline_transcript sentence outline; 15–60 s in all is typical. A range that starts or ends mid-sentence is made anyway, with a warning.

clipId.description: A media clip on the source timeline whose transcript the indices come from.

fromIndex.description: First word of the range: its `index` from timeline_transcript.

transcriptId.description: The `transcriptId` the indices were read from; refused if the clip was transcribed again since.

replace.description: Rebuild this timeline when it already holds a short (default: refuse).

source.description: Timeline to cut from (default "main"). Its silence and retake cuts carry into the short.

targetLufs.description: Export loudness in LUFS (default -14, for Shorts, Reels and TikTok); null for off.

x.description: Horizontal position of the picture: 0 shows the left edge of the source, 0.5 the center, 1 the right edge. Put the speaker in frame.

afterClipId.description: Add a transition after this clip, into the one that follows it.
